office.name: North Dakota Highway Patrol - Motor Carrier Permit Office (Bismarck)

fees.note: Single trip permit $20 (NDCC 39-12-02(3)(f)); 150,001-160,000 lb $30 ... 190,001+ lb $70 (NDAC 38-06-03-01). Valid 5 days for one one-way move.
$10 service/routing fee per single trip permit (Policy 9-6, 11/2025; Annex E 8/2023 still says $8). $5 extra if faxed.

$0.05 per ton-mile on the weight above 200,000 lb (NDAC 38-06-03-01(3)); tiers round up to whole tons, listed to 400,000 lb. May be reduced for axle configuration/road condition. Spring-thaw/load-restricted highways carry separate higher ton-mile fees (not modeled).

escorts.when: Over 16' wide, on two-lane and other roads
Over 16' wide, on interstates and freeways

police.text: 1 police escort. Over 18' wide: NDHP escort if required by the regional commander (Annex E: required for heavy loads unless exempted); NDHP bills $50/hour and $0.50/mile per trooper

restrictions.text: No over-dimensional travel from 1/2 hr after sunset to 1/2 hr before sunrise unless the load is 12' wide or less and 120' long or less (night travel then allowed with clearance lights and amber beacon).
Over 16' wide: no travel after noon Saturday, all day Sunday, or on New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas (from noon the day before until sunrise the day after).
No movement in inclement weather, on slippery roads, or with visibility of 1/2 mile or less; convoy units at least 1,000 ft apart.
Overweight permits not valid on bituminous pavement at 90 F or above; no overweight permits during spring load restrictions (except under the Road Restriction Permit Policy 9-17).
Over 18' high: written authority from utility companies to pass under overhead wires; permittee responsible for all vertical clearances.

travel.weekends: No travel Saturday afternoon or Sunday
travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend

notes: 14 ft 6 in to 16 ft wide on two-lane highways: one lead pilot car is required unless the hauling vehicle carries rotating/flashing amber light(s) visible 500 ft front and rear (Policy 9-15) - the calculator assumes the light option (no escort). No pilot car up to 16' on four-lane divided highways.
Overweight routing limited by NDDOT bridge/approved-gross-weight maps; ND state highways (non-interstate) allow up to 105,500 lb legal, calculator uses 80,000.
Statute allows an online-permit fee of up to $15; policy currently lists a $10 service/routing fee.
Heavy loads (> 200,000 lb) also pay NDDOT traffic control, inspection and a $25 engineering fee when extra analysis is needed; permits not issued in spring restrictions or when heat/rain risk damage.
